animationDescription.message: Bad Apple animation made from Censor Tracker logos

relatedDomainsSaveError.message: Could not save or apply the rules. Some domains may already be saved. Check proxy settings before retrying.

relatedDomainsHelp.message: Read up to 200 hosts from recent resources in this page's main frame. No new requests or history scan. The list can include ads and trackers and may be incomplete. Select only the hosts you need. Existing exclusions stay in effect.

relatedDomainsAdded.message: Added: $1. Existing and excluded domains were not changed.

relatedDomainsError.message: Could not complete this action. The page may have changed or blocked access. Open the popup again and retry.

registrySourceAnticensority.message: Downloads the hostname list from Anticensority's published PAC. No PAC code, proxy addresses, or IP/network rules are used. Invalid hostnames are skipped. This is a large list and can take a few seconds to load.

proxyAntizapretHelp.message: Manual download of Antizapret proxy addresses and allowed domains. Only listed sites can use these proxies, even in proxy-all mode. Select imported entries yourself. General proxy checks are not available. The service supports Russian providers only; downloads can return 403 elsewhere. Import again to refresh the list.

registrySourceHelp.message: Download a JSON array, a JSON object with a domains array, or a text list with one hostname per line. This list is separate from manual site rules. It adds to the built-in registry; turn the built-in registry off to use only this list. Downloads use current routing and send your IP to the source. Files are limited to 32 MB and downloads to 30 seconds. Failed or empty downloads keep the last valid list.

registrySourceAutoUpdate.message: Update automatically with the registry (every 15 minutes while the extension and proxy use are enabled)

registrySourceError.message: Could not save or download this source. Check its URL and format. The last valid list was not deleted.

popupRoute_disabled.message: Censor Tracker proxy routing is inactive

popupRoute_blocked.message: No eligible proxy. This route is blocked.

popupRouteHelp.message: This is the configured route, not a measurement of this page's connection. The browser can use a failover proxy or an existing connection. Exit IP and country come from the last proxy check and may have changed. Opening this popup sends no IP or location requests.

siteRulesHelp.message: Rules apply when a site uses a proxy, including its subdomains. The most specific rule wins. Enter two-letter exit-country codes to refuse (for example RU, CN). An empty list overrides the parent rule with no country restriction. Unknown exit countries and checks older than 24 hours are not permitted under a restriction. Run proxy checks again to update them. If no proxy is eligible, the site is blocked. Location data is an estimate and does not guarantee the route of an existing connection.

siteRuleError.message: Cannot save the rule. Check the hostname and country codes, then try again.

proxyRemoveConfirm.message: Delete all $1 matching custom proxies on all pages, including selected proxies? The built-in proxy will not be deleted.

proxyRecoveryEnabled.message: Allow background IP checks for failed selected proxies (every five minutes). Proxies with saved credentials are not retried automatically.

proxyCheckPrivacy.message: Check uses ipify.org, myip.com, ipwho.is and country.is through each proxy. Cloudflare DNS and country.is receive the proxy host or IP to estimate its location. These services can see your IP. While a check runs, other requests to its test hosts use the same test proxy. No visited site names are sent. Results are estimates, not proof of the route used by a page. Up to four checks run at once; each IP request has an 8-second limit.

proxyCheckError.message: Cannot start or finish the check. Enable the extension and proxy use, select a proxy, and make sure no other check is running.

proxyImportPrivacy.message: Downloads use the current connection and reveal your IP to the source. Use sources you trust. HTTP downloads are not encrypted. New entries are not selected automatically. Removing a subscription keeps its imported proxies.

proxyPacWarning.message: PAC files are not executed. Only proxy addresses are read; routing rules are not imported. These proxies stay blocked until you confirm in Edit that they can serve all sites.

proxyUnrestricted.message: I confirm that this proxy can serve all sites.

proxyImportProtocol.message: Protocol for addresses without a scheme

proxyImportFile.message: Or select a text or PAC file (up to 32 MiB)

proxySubscriptionsEnabled.message: Allow automatic downloads of saved subscriptions (each source once per hour)

proxyImportLimit.message: Import limit reached. Use smaller files (up to 5,000 proxies).

proxyImportFailed.message: Import failed. Check the source, file size, and address format.

proxyAuthPrivacy.message: Credentials are stored on this device and included in settings backups. HTTP proxies do not encrypt the connection to the proxy.

proxySocksUnsupported.message: SOCKS authentication requires Firefox. Chromium does not support it.

proxyPoolHelp.message: Selected proxies share sites and provide backup routes. They do not form a multi-hop chain.

consentIntro.message: Consent covers the connections below. Optional features connect only when enabled or requested.

consentTraffic.message: Selected proxy: your IP, destination domains and routed traffic. HTTPS content stays encrypted; HTTP content is visible to the proxy. Saved proxy credentials go only to that proxy.

consentServices.message: CT services: your IP and requests for your country, proxy lists and site registries. Hosts: geo.ctreserve.de, registry.ctreserve.de, cozyquokka.net, censortracker.github.io and configured mirrors. raw.githubusercontent.com supplies the mirror list. The built-in proxy also receives availability checks from your IP.

consentChecks.message: Proxy checks: api.ipify.org, api.myip.com, ipwho.is and api.country.is see the test connection IP. cloudflare-dns.com receives the proxy hostname; api.country.is receives its server and exit IPs to identify countries. These lookups do not send visited site domains.

consentSources.message: External lists: your IP and the requested URL go to your selected source. Built-in sources: raw.githubusercontent.com/anticensority, p.thenewone.lol:8443 and antizapret.prostovpn.org. Enabled subscriptions update in the background.

consentLocal.message: Local proxy: status, start and stop commands go to localhost:49490. The local app handles traffic in this mode.

consentRetention.message: The operator states that CT servers store no user data, CT proxies keep no logs, and CT uses no tracking IDs.

consentThirdParties.message: Third-party services and custom proxies have their own data practices. These statements do not cover them. A proxy does not guarantee anonymity.

consentPause.message: Declining or withdrawing consent stops CT network functions and removes its proxy setting. The browser may connect directly or use another proxy. Your settings and lists stay saved.

consentControl.message: You can withdraw consent in Settings. Requests already sent cannot be undone; existing browser connections may remain open.

consentGranted.message: Data transmission is allowed. Withdrawal removes CT’s proxy setting; your browser may connect directly or use another proxy.

consentSummary.message: Censor Tracker sends traffic through a proxy to bypass limitations and updates lists in the background. CT servers do not store user data or proxy logs.

consentSummaryDecline.message: Without consent, CT network functions are off. Your browser may connect directly or use another proxy. You can change your choice in settings.

consentPaused.message: Network functions are paused until you agree. CT is not routing traffic; your browser may connect directly or use another proxy.
